text.description_html:
Set Screw for Omnia Stainless Steel Levers.

3/16" long by 1/4-20 stainless steel cone point set screw. For use with Omnia Stainless Steel Leversets.

These (3/16 x 1/4-20 cone point) stainless steel set screws lock Omnia stainless steel levers to the spindle.

*Sold Individually
